name: durable-commerce-runtime

contract: Yalidine, Maystro and legacy ZR capabilities require a current exact connection plus source-reviewed or live-certified evidence
NOEST provider effects remain disabled until its exact provider-issued endpoint contract is independently certified
credential or endpoint drift invalidates execution authority

strengths: watermark retained when any fetched order fails
blockingGaps: watermark can advance after a max-page cutoff while hasMore is true
no durable run/page/item or immutable attempt history
normalized provider PII is not persisted before business mutation
restart and operator replay rely on refetching the provider
errors are response strings instead of retry/quarantine/dead-letter state
polling and future webhook ingress do not converge on one durable item identity

queue: POST creates or returns one active run per platform and returns 202
request handlers never fetch provider pages or mutate orders inline
active-shop worker is the only run and item executor
pagination: adapters expose one provider page plus an opaque continuation cursor
every fetched page is persisted before any item is processed
candidate watermark is accumulated but never committed while a continuation cursor remains
page budgets yield and requeue; they never discard continuation
items: each normalized provider order is encrypted at rest before canonical processing
item identity binds platform, source order id and source revision
one leased item attempt executes at a time
canonical command replay makes restart after mutation safe
conflicts become quarantined or dead-letter state, not response-only strings
watermark: watermark advances atomically only after fetch completion and every item is succeeded or skipped
partial, retrying, quarantined or dead-letter runs retain the previous watermark
recovery: no decrypted provider payload or customer PII leaves the service boundary
inactive-shop runs remain durable and are not drained

implementationOrder: page cursor adapter contract with compatibility wrappers
history and audited retry APIs plus AR/FR/EN UI
restart, overlap, cursor, watermark, tamper and dead-letter tests
separated adversarial review and source closure

constraints.productionScopeAuthorized: durable commerce runs, pages, items, attempts, operator recovery and pagination continuation only
